title: Jack & Bobby
premise_summary: Jack & Bobby is an American drama television series created by Greg Berlanti, Vanessa Taylor, Steven A. Cohen, and Brad Meltzer. It aired on The WB from September 12, 2004, to May 11, 2005. The series' title is a reference to real-life political brothers John and Robert Kennedy.
